author: blu
body: ControlNet for spatially-conditioned image generation. Takes a control image (edge map, depth map, pose, etc.) and injects spatial conditioning into the UNet at each down/mid block via trainable zero-conv layers.

author: blu
body: Architecture: a copy of the UNet encoder (down blocks + mid block) processes the control image in parallel. Zero-conv output from each block is added to the corresponding main UNet block output.
